oss_source.method_note: 本仓无 MCMP（无组分概念、无组分输运方程）；两组分分层 Poiseuille 无法直接映射。可借用的只是相场的分层初始化几何写法与变密度平衡态装配，把"两组分"降级为"两相分层"来近似。

decision: Cross-validate TensorLBM's no-MCMP two-phase (fill-level free-surface) capability against walberla's no-MCMP two-phase approach on the Martin & Moyce (1952) planar dam break, the same showcase walberla ships for exactly this model family.
alternatives: A1 (primary): TensorLBM fill-level Korner free surface (tensorlbm.free_surface_lbm, D3Q19 slab nz=4 free-slip span) via benchmarks/dam_break/fslbm_driver.py — direct approach counterpart of walberla's fill-level model
A2 (secondary): TensorLBM color-gradient pseudo-potential dam break (tensorlbm.verification.dam_break_2d_validation) — different two-phase family, same 'no-MCMP two-phase' class

A3 (rejected): build & run walberla C++ itself — CMake+codegen build cost disproportionate; OSS approach extracted from source instead (zero hand-copy), both arms compared to the same experimental reference
hypothesis: TensorLBM fill-level two-phase reproduces the Martin & Moyce experimental front position within 15% (owner criterion) at t* <= 3, with a consistent two-resolution convergence trend; the color-gradient arm agrees at the same level, showing the no-MCMP two-phase class is sound in this repo.

case.name: planar dam break, Martin & Moyce (1952) geometry
case.geometry: water column width L, height h0 = 2L (columnRatio=2, same as walberla prm); domain 4L x 2h0; free-slip walls

metrics.M1_front: X* = x_front/L vs MM data at t* in {1.0, 2.0, 3.0}; front = last x with depth >= 0.5 cells

thresholds.convergence: two resolutions per arm; trend must not diverge (coarse error not >2x fine error at matched t*)

B_color_gradient.note: existing repo driver, its own t* conversion

stopping_rule: If arm A is NaN/crash at both resolutions -> honest FAIL at fail_stage=armA_run, report arm B as repo-side evidence, record friction. No threshold tuning after seeing results.
confounders: Re choice: fixed reynolds_target=2000 across resolutions (grid-independent Re); walberla runs Re~1.35e6 with Smagorinsky — early-time front (t*<=3) is gravity-inertia dominated, Re sensitivity secondary
D3Q19 slab vs D2Q9: span is a symmetry direction with free-slip walls; documented in driver docstring
front threshold 0.5 cells: O(1/L) = 1-2% at L=50-100, below the 15% gate
environment: CPU torch, TL_THREADS=8, float32, worktree /root/tp-agent/work/m18067 branch agent/m18067
analysis: errors computed programmatically from results.json; figures from the same JSON (zero hand-copy)
